After Arnold Böcklin · 1880

Isle of the Dead

Evening on a still sea; the last light on the rock, the cypresses already dark, a boat crossing to the landing.

Drag to look around · scroll to zoom · Walk: W A S D, Shift to run, E / Q up and down

Director0.0 s

Alt-click the scene to copy a position.

Shoot

Frame inside the box: drag to look, right-drag to slide, scroll to move in. Place, then click the ground to stand the camera there. Aim, then click what to look at.

Post

Print-style dot screens over the whole picture, one per colour channel.

Grain over the whole picture, from fine film grain to TV static.

Colour grading through a 3D lookup table: a look applied to every colour in the picture.

Chromatic aberration: red and blue split apart toward the edges of the frame, as through a simple lens.

Afterimage: bright things leave trails that fade. Higher damp means longer trails.

Shots, Record and renders use these settings too.

Effects

Effects from the Effects page, placed in this valley and lit by its air. Choose a look, then click the ground to place it.

Guests

Characters from the Rigging Bench, lit by this scene. Pick a model and a crowd, then click the ground to place it. Walking and jogging guests roam within the Roam distance (0 keeps them on the spot).

Characters

Untick to hide a character. New ones get names you can use in scripts.
